title: 修复输出
problem_statement_md:
我们期望代码应该向屏幕输出 "**this is some text**"。然而，这段代码有许多错误。

请修复代码以输出预期的文本。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Fix the Code[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given code that should output "[b]this is some text[/b]" to the screen. However, the code has a number of errors.
[note]Fix the code to output the expected text.[/note]
